legal.privacyBody:
Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

We collect the details you provide when booking or contacting us — such as your name, contact details and travel documents — and use them solely to deliver and improve our services.

We never sell your data. We share it only with trusted partners (airlines, hotels, visa authorities) strictly to fulfil your booking. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting our support team.
legal.termsBody:
By using this website and booking our services, you agree to the following terms.

Bookings are confirmed once payment (or the agreed deposit) is received. Prices are shown in the selected currency and may change until a booking is confirmed. Cancellation and refund terms vary by package and are shown at checkout.

We act as an agent for airlines, hotels and other suppliers and are not liable for changes caused by those third parties or by events beyond our reasonable control. Travellers are responsible for holding valid travel documents and visas.
